data.narrative:
Peak Quantum is a pre-seed stage quantum computing company seeking valuation. The broader sector comp universe includes 3 public companies (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 6 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, D-Wave Quantum, Rigetti Computing, and Infleqtion.

The Stage-Progression method is the applicable triangulation approach given data constraints. Using Peak Quantum's €5M total raised as a base value proxy and applying a standard 2.5x step-up multiplier for progression from Pre-Seed to the next stage yields an implied valuation of $12M. The Peer-Median method is not applicable; while 6 same-sector peers exist, none meet narrow filtering criteria (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier), yielding insufficient datapoints for reliable median calibration.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $11M to $14M, with a central estimate of $12M. This range reflects the single applicable method and carries material uncertainty given the absence of stage-and-sector-specific peer comparables. Key uncertainties include the appropriate step-up multiplier for this specific technology frontier and the extent to which broader sector multiples—observable in public quantum companies—should inform pre-seed valuation. Additional conviction would require either identifying same-stage quantum computing peers or securing comparable transaction data from recent pre-seed quantum funding rounds.
